deterministic_overlap_v1.aggregation: mean over three masked observations per window point; overlap-add then mean over covering windows; mean channels
deterministic_overlap_v1.anomaly_ratios: 0.5 through 10 in 0.5 steps, then 11 through 51 in 1 steps: 61 candidates
deterministic_overlap_v1.coverage: each output point must be covered, save window and masked-observation counts
deterministic_overlap_v1.error: squared reconstruction error only at masked positions in training StandardScaler units
deterministic_overlap_v1.gate: deterministic soft probability of keep class; no hard Gumbel sampling
deterministic_overlap_v1.mask_dependence: fixed bank, invariant to global RNG and window visitation history
deterministic_overlap_v1.model_compute_precision: unchanged checkpoint/reference float32 path; no AMP
deterministic_overlap_v1.required_repeat: two full train+validation scoring passes, compare every saved array bytewise, change RNG state between passes
deterministic_overlap_v1.scoring_function: score_series for BOTH percentile calibration and final validation predictions
deterministic_overlap_v1.selection: ordinary point F1 maximum on proposal validation; first ratio in frozen order wins ties
deterministic_overlap_v1.selection_rule: maximum ordinary point F1 on proposal validation; first frozen-order candidate wins ties
deterministic_overlap_v1.threshold_pool: 4515 unique training-point scores concatenated with 1412 unique validation-point scores; labels excluded

diagnostic_definitions.FP_distance: integer distance to nearest true positive point; disjoint bins 0-1,2-3,4-5,6-10,>10
diagnostic_definitions.boundary_expansion_FP: FP in a predicted run that also overlaps a true run
diagnostic_definitions.boundary_offset: predicted minus true; negative start is early, positive end is late
diagnostic_definitions.event_iou: mean best-match IoU over all true runs, unmatched true runs assigned zero
diagnostic_definitions.event_matching: best IoU predicted run per true run, earliest predicted run on ties; many-to-many hit accounting
diagnostic_definitions.event_precision: predicted runs overlapping any true run / all predicted runs
diagnostic_definitions.event_recall: true runs overlapping any predicted run / all true runs
diagnostic_definitions.events: maximal contiguous positive runs, inclusive start/end, one index equals one minute
diagnostic_definitions.false_alarm_episode: predicted run overlapping no true run
diagnostic_definitions.far_independent_FP: FP in a nonoverlapping predicted run, farther than 10 minutes from any true run
diagnostic_definitions.near_optimal: F1 >= best_F1 - 0.01; width is contiguous sampled component containing the best candidate, no interpolation
diagnostic_definitions.threshold_sensitivity: adjacent candidate F1 change, threshold slope, prediction flips; plus diagnostic +/-1% and +/-5% threshold perturbations, not new selection candidates

disclosures.full_window_statistical_prompt_mask_acce: The existing full-window statistical prompt can access statistics from positions that are masked for reconstruction.
disclosures.gate_difference_from_historical: deterministic_overlap_v1 uses a deterministic soft gate; historical scoring used a hard Gumbel gate.
disclosures.interpretation_guardrail: Deterministic results are checkpoint rescoring results and must not be described as an improvement caused by model retraining.

historical.checkpoint_relation: best.pt weights byte-identical to evaluation_start.pt for both services

input_source: prefix-only cache with pre-existing historical canonical-byte SHA256 identity
